observations.observation: Slogan is first and plants/people remain the broad horizontal event. Identifiers are subordinate and adjacent beneath prose.
Flat warm planes and sharper outlines increase, but detailed anime-like faces and background remain.

style.default_template_exclusion_observation: The actual choosing visitor and pot-tending grower share a continuous densely inhabited tabletop. Plants at multiple scales and the two contact/posture actions organize the full scene; no tiny-image strip, separate information card or empty-room dressing.

ratio.policy: Nearest integer one-edge rounding <=0.5 pixel. Original never resized.

observations.observation: Contrasting plant choices near the leaning visitor, grower holding newly potted tree, soil and repotting tools express selection and care.
Open internal counters, stable consonant/vowel bodies and clear word boundaries. Type stays flat and untextured.
Continuation now larger and readable during this inspection; smallest access/care remain somewhat smaller than explanation.
Market name, date, hours and venue have adjacent stable starts; modest gap to access/care and immediate invitation/URL continuation.
The shared horizontal encounter leads laterally, but the detailed central plant mass continues to interrupt the intended direct lip handoff.
Each hand connects to its own sleeve and holds a side of the pot rim; no visible detached hand or ownership ambiguity.
Forward posture and gaze toward two nearby plants show considering a choice; hand remains at chin.
Ink outlines and colored surfaces are coherent; simple pot soil/rim contacts legible. Some naturalistic shading and dense leaf detail persist.

residuals.observation: Central foliage still separates the paragraph from the market name. Shared tabletop connects the encounter, but the specific uninterrupted lip handoff near the paragraph end was not fully realized.
Flatter color areas and stronger contours increased, while faces, hair, leaf veins and greenhouse detail remain more intricate than the assigned economical ink-plane direction.
Access/care are more legible than repair-1, though slightly smaller than the left explanation. No universal readability guarantee made.

decision.reason: Compared with the two inspected earlier stages, this preserves slogan-first hierarchy and complete visible copy, materially enlarges the right visit continuation and modestly simplifies the illustration. Remaining handoff and stylistic limits are retained.
